Watts made this hymn from Psalm 121, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? 2My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth. 3He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber. 4Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. … 4 more verses PSALM 121 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 121
To heav'n I lift my waiting eyes, There all my hopes are laid: The Lord that built the earth and skies Is my perpetual aid. STANZA I
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 121. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
